name: Amateur radio Technician exam (2026–2030 pool)
description: Every question in the official question pool for the Technician class amateur radio licence exam (Element 2), with its three wrong answers. The pool is used for exams from July 1, 2026 to June 30, 2030. The exam asks 35 multiple-choice questions, one from each topic group, and you pass with 26 right.
